candidate_workaround: Classify only exact scanner-definition lines and explicit sanitizer-negative assertions as definition candidates; keep every other match confirmed and fail closed.
failure_signature: The first staged privacy review treated five scanner-definition and negative-assertion literals as payload hits and stopped before receipts.
recurrence_guard: A privacy scanner may classify a candidate only when the exact line is a compiled pattern definition or an explicit rejecting assertion in a named test; never exclude a file or class wholesale.
rollback: Give the failed staged review zero credit, retain all five candidates, and write no privacy or manifest receipt until exact classification yields zero unclassified hits.
scope_boundary: Owner-local structural privacy classification only; no privacy-complete, security-complete, scientific, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Quarantine exact privacy scanner definitions without weakening payload scans
trigger_preconditions: A five-class scanner reports its own compiled patterns or an explicit negative assertion as a candidate.
